text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 4 — R-mode, 4-wire Kelvin (K1 energised, K2 energised)
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 4/7
inside STM32: OPAMP3, PGA mode, G = 1 + Rf/Rg = 2…64
Loop: OPAMP1 drives Q1 until MUXR_COM = VREF (0.405 V) ⇒ test current I = VREF / R_sense.
U4: 00 → R5 98.9 Ω · 01 → R6 993.6 Ω · 10 → R7 98.6 kΩ · 11 → R8 4.7 MΩ (A = B = MUXR_A0, C = MUXR_A1); R31 100 kΩ pull-up on MUXR_EN.
R = RSENSE_eff × [ (V_ADC3 − V_ADC4) / G − V_os,short ] / V(PA7); ADC3 and ADC4 sampled simultaneously.
COMP4 (internal): PB0 vs DAC1_CH1 2.6 V — over-voltage guard shuts R-mode down. OPAMP3 out = V_SL + G·(V_SH − V_SL).
U9 LED: pin 1 = +3V3, pin 2 → R41 330 Ω → K1_C, so U9 conducts whenever K1 is energised (R-mode only).
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
